summary: José Vicente de Freitas (1869–1952) was an army officer who was President of the Ministry from April 1928 to July 1929, the head of government the Ditadura Nacional put in the post when Óscar Carmona left it for the presidency. He is in the atlas as one of the three men who led the government between the coup of 1926 and Salazar.
